known_issues.name: USB_host_transfer_initial_API_timeout_once
known_issues.details: One initial Android-to-PC handoff timed out waiting for WHC_API_WIFI_SET_USR_CFG (0x7), and RTS reset recovered it. Follow-up passed 3 interface rebinds, 3 device reauthorizations, 3 USB bus resets, 1 Windows-to-VM handoff, and a physical PC-to-YM6252-to-PC round trip, all without MCU/RTS reset. Mandatory reset on host transfer is not established; the original timeout root cause remains unknown.
